sovereign_question: What evidence entity, bounded claim, locator, role and gate state may the horizontal research corpus assert without confusing adoption, provenance, semantic authority, implementation qualification or executed acceptance?
negative_charter: Does not define product or bounded-context semantics.
Does not promote an organization, brand, product, project or foundation into a canonical product.
Does not infer legal identity, acquisition, rename, parentage, control or succession from names, domains or shared branding.
Does not treat a homepage or source URL as proof of a bounded claim.
Does not treat an independent product implementation as semantic authority.
Does not convert a proposed evidence role into semantic ratification.
Does not invent implementation qualification or executed vertical acceptance.
Does not require optional AI or agent functionality.
gate_laws: Research proposal may prepare evidence and decisions but may not mint semantic authority.
Semantic ratification requires a named authority decision over an exact payload.
Implementation qualification requires reproducible implementation evidence against an exact contract.
Executed acceptance requires a physical occurrence and acceptance receipt for the declared vertical and environment.
Later gates imply neither portability nor a different gate unless an explicit contract says so.

exact_support_requires: recoverable source representation or source-state identifier
validator-confirmed match to the bounded claim
